chunks: Abu al-Hasan narrated to us, he said: Ali ibn Ahmad al-Tabari narrated to us, he said: Abu Sa'id narrated to us, he said: Karrash narrated to us, he said: My master Anas narrated to us, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) said:

Whoever says: 'Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him', Allah writes for him a million good deeds, erases from him a million bad deeds, and raises him a million degrees; and whoever adds [to it], Allah adds for him, and whoever seeks forgiveness, Allah forgives him.

key_terms.دَرَجَةً: Degree / Rank (in paradise or spiritual status)
key_terms.سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him (a specific dhikr formula)

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards of saying Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, this hadith emphasizes the transformative power of *Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi* as a comprehensive act of worship that simultaneously purifies the soul and elevates the believer's spiritual station. The promise of a million good deeds and sins erased reflects the Shia scholarly view that consistent, sincere dhikr serves as a means of divine mercy and rapid spiritual ascent, reinforcing the practical importance of this remembrance in daily devotional life.
